desktop.title: Better on your phone
desktop.body: Parmelia is designed to be used on your phone. You can keep trying it here on your computer, but the best experience is on mobile.

security.whatIsKeyBody1: It's like your house key, but digital: it lives on your device and works with your fingerprint or face. There's no password to steal or forget.
security.whatIsKeyBody2: Every payment is signed with that key. You can have several (phone, computer); adding a backup key is the best way to never lose access.
security.faqParmeliaTitle: What can Parmelia do with my account?
security.faqParmeliaBody: Very little, on purpose. Parmelia can't move, freeze or spend your money: only you sign with your keys. The only thing we can do is start a 48-hour recovery, which you can cancel from any device.

recover.title: Recover your account
recover.loginLink: Lost your phone or your access key?
recover.loginHint: Don't worry: sign in with your email or Google as usual. Then we'll help you recover access to your account.
recover.promise: Parmelia helps you recover access without ever holding your money. Your account is still yours: we only start the process, and you approve it with a new key.
recover.step1: Create a new access key on this device.
recover.step2: Wait 48 hours. It's a safety period: if someone else tried to take over your account, you'd have time to cancel it.
recover.step3: Activate your new key and you're done.
recover.warning: Important: when the recovery completes, your previous keys will stop working. If you find your old device before activating the new key, you can cancel the request.
recover.creatingKey: Follow your device's instructions to create the key
recover.pendingBody: You'll be able to activate your new key on {{date}}.
recover.pendingWhy: This wait protects your account: if you didn't ask for this, you have 48 hours to cancel it from any device.
recover.pendingOldDevice: Found your old device? You can cancel this request and keep using your account as usual.
recover.cancelConfirm: Tap again to confirm the cancellation
recover.elsewhereBody: This request was started from another device. To continue there, open it on that device. If you no longer have it, cancel and start over from here.
recover.readyBody: When you activate it, your previous keys will stop working on all your devices.
recover.successBody: You can now use Parmelia from this device. Your previous keys no longer work. Your money never moved.
recover.cancelledBody: Everything is as it was: your current keys work normally.
recover.keyDismissed: The key wasn't created. You can try again whenever you want.
recover.errorBody: We couldn't complete the step. Your account didn't change. Try again in a moment.
recover.noWalletBody: This account doesn't have a wallet yet, so there's nothing to recover.
recover.bannerBody: This device doesn't have an access key for your account. If you lost your previous phone, we can help you recover access. If everything works normally, ignore this notice.
recover.settingsBody: If you lose your device, you can create a new key. The change takes 48 hours for your security and your money never leaves your account.
